subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway disconnect, should `openclaw agent` recover the original run first and then automatically use the isolated fallback on exhaustion, or should exhaustion fail closed unless the user explicitly reruns?
rationale: Either option intentionally changes the current documented fallback contract, including stdout latency, whether users receive an authoritative versus newly generated result, and whether ambiguous requests may execute again.

options.title: Recovery first, isolated fallback on exhaustion
options.body: Adopt recovery-first as the default, retain the current isolated embedded fallback only after the original run cannot be recovered, and require final-head proof.

options.title: Recovery first, fail closed on exhaustion
options.body: Require explicit user opt-in to rerun after an unresolved outcome and document the new CLI flag and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep current fallback contract
options.body: Retain immediate isolated fallback and close or substantially narrow this PR because the recovery-first interaction cost is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Recovery first, isolated fallback on exhaustion
recommendation.body: Adopt recovery-first as the default, retain the current isolated embedded fallback only after the original run cannot be recovered, and require final-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current fallback containment behavior and are the clearest history-backed owner for its successor contract.
